reviews.text: The environment and people of this salon are the absolute best. They are very attentive and caring. I did a lived in color treatment with Brandy and I have no words. My hair is absolutely beautiful and she did it just how I imagined. She is very knowledgeable and has a passion for hair services. 10/10

Brandy is the best! She really transformed my orange hair to a perfect blonde in just one session. Just recently got a Brazilian blowout with her as well— fully recommend! The nicest, most attentive stylist at Sol!

I’m obsessed with my new hair! The balayage turned out better than I imagined. Brandy gave my hair such a natural, sun-kissed look. The whole experience, from start to finish, was super smooth and enjoyable. I left the salon feeling so refreshed and confident. Huge thank you to Brandy for bringing my hair back to life!
